import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Data provided as a string
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Convert 'is_fraud' to a more descriptive categorical label for better readability in plots
df['is_fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'No Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})

# Set a clean style for the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure with a 2x2 subplot grid
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Analysis by Fraud Status', fontsize=18, y=1.02) # Overall title for the figure

# Plot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud_label', data=df, ax=axes[0, 0], palette='viridis')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Fraud Status')

# Plot 2: Count of Transactions by Type and Fraud Status
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud_label', data=df, ax=axes[0, 1], palette='viridis')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Count by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Fraud Status')

# Plot 3: Count of Transactions by Hour of Day and Fraud Status
# Order the x-axis by hour of day for better time series representation
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud_label', data=df, ax=axes[1, 0], palette='viridis', order=sorted(df['hour_of_day'].unique()))
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transaction Count by Hour of Day and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Fraud Status')

# Plot 4: Density Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status
# Using KDE plot to visualize the distribution of transaction amounts
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud_label', fill=True, common_norm=False, palette='viridis', ax=axes[1, 1], linewidth=2)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Fraud Status')

# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping elements, leaving space for the suptitle
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98])

# Save the figure to a file
plt.savefig('output.png')
